auth.v1.CreateApiPolicyRequest.description:
CreateApiPolicyRequest defines a new API key policy template.
perp_allowlist_requires_markets // perp_markets must be non-empty when perp_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
perp_markets_unique // perp_markets must not contain duplicate symbols
spot_allowlist_requires_markets // spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets_unique // spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbols

actions.description:
High-level actions enabled for the API key policy. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions are allowed.
actions.title: actions

assignToKeyId.description:
Optional API key identifier to bind this newly-created policy to
 atomically. When set, the caller must be allowed to manage the key and the
 create+assign operation consumes a single fresh step-up proof.
assignToKeyId.title: assign_to_key_id

dailyInternalTransferOutLimit.description:
Maximum total notional this API key can transfer out internally per rolling
 day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A
 value of 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.
dailyInternalTransferOutLimit.title: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit

dailyWithdrawLimit.description:
Maximum total notional this API key can withdraw per rolling day, expressed
 in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means
 no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.
dailyWithdrawLimit.title: daily_withdraw_limit

description.description: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.
description.title: description

isTemplate.description: Whether this policy should be treated as a reusable template.
isTemplate.title: is_template

maxOrderNotional.description:
Maximum notional size for any single order submitted with this API key,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.
maxOrderNotional.title: max_order_notional

name.description: Human-readable policy name. Required; 1 to 64 characters.
name.title: name

perpMarketScope.description: Market-level scope for perp contracts. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.
perpMarketScope.title: perp_market_scope

perpMarkets.description: Allowed perp markets and optional per-contract leverage caps.
perpMarkets.title: perp_markets

spotMarketScope.description: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.
spotMarketScope.title: spot_market_scope

spotMarkets.description: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.
spotMarkets.title: spot_markets

auth.v1.CreateApiPolicyRequest.title: CreateApiPolicyRequest

auth.v1.CreateApiPolicyResponse.description: CreateApiPolicyResponse returns the created API key policy.
auth.v1.CreateApiPolicyResponse.title: CreateApiPolicyResponse

auth.v1.CreateSubaccountPolicyRequest.description:
CreateSubaccountPolicyRequest defines a new sub-account policy template, with
 an optional attach step for one target sub-account.
perp_allowlist_requires_markets // perp_markets must be non-empty when perp_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
perp_markets_unique // perp_markets must not contain duplicate symbols
spot_allowlist_requires_markets // spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets_unique // spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbols

actions.description:
High-level actions enabled for the sub-account policy. Up to 64 unique
 explicit actions are allowed.
actions.title: actions

dailyInternalTransferOutLimit.description:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can transfer out internally per
 rolling day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example,
 micro-USDT). A value of 0 means no explicit cap.
dailyInternalTransferOutLimit.title: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit

dailyLossLimit.description:
Maximum realized loss over a rolling day before safety controls may halt
 activity, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT).
 A value of 0 means no explicit limit.
dailyLossLimit.title: daily_loss_limit

dailyWithdrawLimit.description:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can withdraw per rolling day,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no explicit cap.
dailyWithdrawLimit.title: daily_withdraw_limit

description.description: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.
description.title: description

enforceWithdrawWhitelist.description:
When true, external withdrawals from this sub-account must target an
 approved withdrawal destination.
enforceWithdrawWhitelist.title: enforce_withdraw_whitelist

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

globalNotionalCap.description:
Maximum total notional exposure across all positions for this sub-account,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no explicit cap.
globalNotionalCap.title: global_notional_cap

globalPerpLeverageX.description:
Optional global leverage cap across all perp contracts. Supported non-zero
 values are 1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100. A value of 0 means no explicit cap.
globalPerpLeverageX.title: global_perp_leverage_x

internalTransfersOwnOnly.description:
When true, internal transfers from this sub-account may only target other
 sub-accounts owned by the same root account.
internalTransfersOwnOnly.title: internal_transfers_own_only

intradayDrawdownLimitBps.description:
Maximum drawdown from peak equity in basis points. One basis point is
 1/100 of one percent. A value of 0 means no explicit limit.
intradayDrawdownLimitBps.title: intraday_drawdown_limit_bps

liquidationOnly.description: When true, this sub-account may only reduce or close existing exposure.
liquidationOnly.title: liquidation_only

locked.description: When true, the policy is write-protected and requires an elevated mutation path.
locked.title: locked

maxOpenOrders.description:
Maximum number of resting orders allowed on this sub-account at any time.
 A value of 0 means no explicit cap.
maxOpenOrders.title: max_open_orders

maxOpenPositions.description:
Maximum number of open perp positions allowed on this sub-account. A value
 of 0 means no explicit cap.
maxOpenPositions.title: max_open_positions

maxOrderNotional.description:
Maximum notional size for any single order on this sub-account, expressed
 in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means
 no explicit cap.
maxOrderNotional.title: max_order_notional

name.description: Human-readable policy name. Required; 1 to 64 characters.
name.title: name

perpMarketScope.description: Market-level scope for perp contracts. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.
perpMarketScope.title: perp_market_scope

perpMarkets.description: Allowed perp markets and optional per-contract leverage caps.
perpMarkets.title: perp_markets

reviewAt.description: Optional review time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.
reviewAt.title: review_at

spotMarketScope.description: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.
spotMarketScope.title: spot_market_scope

spotMarkets.description: Allowed spot markets for this policy.
spotMarkets.title: spot_markets

subaccountId.description:
Optional: if set, the created policy will be immediately attached to this
 sub-account (opaque ID) in the same request. Useful for "create
 policy for this sub-account" flows. Omit to create reusable templates.
subaccountId.title: subaccount_id

tradingHalted.description:
When true, new orders for this sub-account are rejected regardless of other
 policy settings.
tradingHalted.title: trading_halted
